text:
maria: Heads-up — proposing an on-prem change window for Clearwater Labs (private/VPC). Target: Tue 2026-03-25 02:30-04:30 UTC. Scope: runtime rollout (v3.2.2), small DB migration (add index + stats), and firewall rule flip. Need owners for smoke checks, rollback readiness, and network handoff. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/clearwater-onprem

maria: Smoke checklist draft (please amend):
```
- verify cluster health /nodes and /health endpoints
- sample inference on model v3.2.2 (100 prompt batch)
- check token accounting and billing labels
- confirm KV cache warm-up executed
- run e2e sample flows from customer VPN
- verify metrics: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, token-rate
```

kev: I can own the smoke tests and acceptance. 02:30 start works better for our backups. I'll be on-call during the window.

sophie: 02:30 fine for platform. I'll be primary for runtime rollback. Suggest rollback triggers: >5% request error rate over 5m OR p95 latency >3s for 5m. Agree?

ryan: I'll own DB migration. Doing a dry-run tonight on staging and will post results. Note: migration includes an index build — adds ~30s table lock on our test set, plan to run during low traffic. I'll add VACUUM step to runbook.

deploy-bot: Tentative schedule created: Tue 2026-03-25 02:30 UTC. Network notification scheduled: 24h before. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

maria: Rollback plan (short): immediate traffic switch to model variant v3.2.1 + restore DB from snapshot if migration fails at step X. Snapshots retained for 24h. Rollback commands:
```
# traffic switch
redwood traffic route set --customer clearwater --variant v3.2.1
# DB restore (if needed)
pg_restore --host=db-prod-clearwater --snapshot /snapshots/clearwater_pre_mig.sql
```

sam: I'll coordinate the firewall change with the customer's network team and confirm the maintenance window with them by EOD today.

ryan: Also adding KV cache warmup script to the deploy job. I'll push to the deploy branch and tag the runbook.

sophie: Final smoke checklist I'll run during window (short):
```
1) curl https://api-clearwater.internal/health -> 200
2) python samples/run_inference.py --model v3.2.2 --count 10 -> no errors
3) check metrics in datadog: token-rate, error-rate, p50/p95 latency
4) verify NGINX upstream count and 502/503 = 0
5) run customer e2e through VPN tunnel
```

maria: If you're owning a task, please reply with 'ack' and include pager. We'll triage escalations based on these owners.

kev: ack — kev (pager: kev-oncall)

sophie: ack — sophie (pager: sophie-platform)

sam: ack — sam (pager: sam-net)

ryan: ack — ryan (pager: ryan-db)

deploy-bot: Schedule confirmed once all acks received. Final reminder will go out 24h before window.

maria: Thanks all — I'll update the runbook with final timings and the explicit rollback checklist. Ping here if anything changes.
